ByteDance is a technology company focused on inspiring creativity and enriching life through a suite of global products and platforms. The Backend and Infra Software Engineer Graduate will develop and optimize research and development infrastructure, including IDEs, code management systems, CI/CD pipelines, and microservice platforms. The role will also explore AI applications, conduct technical research, and maintain company-level R&D systems.

Responsibilities
R&D Infrastructure Construction : Participate in developing core R&D tools such as IDE, code management systems, and CI/CD pipelines to optimize the efficiency and stability of R&D processes 
AI Technology Implementation : Explore the application of AI in scenarios like code generation, fault diagnosis, and dependency management, and participate in the construction of AI R&D toolchains to enhance team R&D efficiency 
Technical Research and Transformation : Track cutting-edge technologies such as distributed systems, cloud-native, and large models, and transform new technologies into practical R&D tools and solutions to serve internal business lines 
System Maintenance and Optimization : Participate in daily maintenance of company-level R&D platforms, resolve technical issues, and continuously optimize system performance and user experience

Required
- Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering or a related discipline
- Proficient in at least one backend programming language (such as Go, Java, Python, C++) with solid programming foundation
- Understand computer principles, data structures and algorithms, and have basic system design thinking
- Have basic knowledge of distributed systems, databases, message queues, and CI/CD processes
- Possess strong learning ability and problem-solving skills, and can quickly adapt to new technologies and business scenarios
- Have team collaboration spirit and can effectively communicate with cross-functional teams
Preferred
- Have project experience in AI tool development, large model applications, or cloud-native related fields
- Have participated in open source projects with code submission records or technical blog outputs
- Understand DevOps concepts and have internship experience related to CI/CD processes or R&D tools
